::: {#exm-min-max-wcgs}
#### Min-max scaling of cholesterol in the WCGS

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
chol_range <- range(wcgs$chol, na.rm = TRUE)
chol_minmax <- (wcgs$chol - chol_range[1]) / diff(chol_range)
range(chol_minmax, na.rm = TRUE)
```

The smallest cholesterol value maps to 0 and the largest maps to 1.
The scaled values keep the shape of the distribution
but lose the units.
:::
